title: Sebastian and the Protocol
author: Xanthe Ashgrove
blurb: Zephyrine Okonkwo, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
